scope: Offline validation split only; test split not used for inference

settings.replay_nms: class-aware Ultralytics TorchNMS.nms; boxes offset by class_id * 7680
settings.matching: Separate class-agnostic and exact combined-class maximum-cardinality one-to-one Hungarian assignments; reward=eligible*(min(n_pred,n_gt)+1+iou), eligible requires IoU>=0.5 and additionally same class for exact-class metrics
settings.count_definition: Per-image visible labeled boxes; does not estimate physical fingers uniquely across multiple cameras
settings.dominant_class_grouping: Most frequent ground-truth combined class in each image; first label breaks count ties

limitations: Validation annotations count visible instances, not unique physical fingers across cameras.
Validation performance cannot establish live-camera accuracy or causal standalone-demo parity.
Exact combined-class labels require both cultivar and ripeness to match.
Earlier cached inference runtime is not included in elapsed_seconds_this_resume.
No model weights, application inference settings, saved configuration, or live resources were modified.
